title: PRD: Temporal quota prioritization and auto-credit arbitration for mixed-plan usage
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers operating multiple product lines and environments (web, mobile, backend) frequently run into transient quota exhaustion on one plan while other plans still have unused credits. Current behavior (hard per-plan caps, or naive burst credits) either causes customer-facing throttles or requires manual billing adjustments. This PRD defines a system that: (1) enables temporal prioritization rules across entitlements so teams can nominate primary/secondary quotas per caller/route; (2) implements auto-credit arbitration to spill usage from exhausted quotas to lower-cost backup credits with configurable priorities and soft rollback; and (3) exposes reconciliation and invoice visibility hooks for finance and SRE teams.
goals: Allow admins to configure ordered priority lists of entitlements (plan buckets or credit sets) per caller or route
Enable automatic spillover from higher-priority to lower-priority entitlements within configured policies with near-real-time enforcement
Surface deterministic billing reconciliation metadata to invoice generation and finance UI so automated refunds/adjustments are auditable
Prevent silent cost surprises by providing soft-overage alerts, pre-approval gating for high-cost spillover, and fine-grained webhooks
non_goals: Replacing existing global per-customer billing engine (we will emit events and reconciled rows for downstream billing)
Complex predictive credit trading models in year 1 (we will implement deterministic rules only)
End-to-end UI redesign beyond targeted admin pages and invoice detail screens
scope: Config model to attach a priority-ordered list of entitlements to callers, API keys, or routes
Request-time enforcement with atomic check-and-debit across prioritized buckets (best-effort within 250ms budget)
Reconciliation output: per-request spill event, original and charged entitlement IDs, per-token cost differential, and reason codes
Billing connector: append spill events to billing pipeline as 'spill_adjustment' rows consumed by invoice generator
api_requirements: New API: POST /v1/entitlements/priorities - attach priority lists to an API key or route (idempotent)
Enforcement hook: augment /v1/generate and embedding endpoints with X-Entitlement-Decision response headers detailing chosen bucket and fallbacks
Admin API: GET /v1/entitlements/{caller}/spill-history?start=&end=&limit= - returns spill events for reconciliation
Webhook: entitlement.spill and entitlement.near_limit (retryable, signed) to be consumed by customer ops
Audit attribute: include spill_decision_id on every log and tracing span for downstream debugging
entitlement_primitives: Plan bucket: opaque id representing a plan or credit set (monthly quota, burst credits, reserved capacity)
Priority list: ordered array of plan buckets with associated gating rules
Soft window: configurable window where spillover is allowed but tagged as 'soft' to enable automated refunds if usage reverts
Preapproval token: time-limited token issued by billing UI to allow high-cost spillovers without further human approval
billing_acceptance_criteria: When a caller exhausts primary bucket and spills to secondary, the billing pipeline receives a spill_adjustment row with original_bucket_id, charged_bucket_id, tokens_charged, cost_delta, timestamp, and spill_decision_id
Invoice UI shows spill events grouped by day and caller with cost deltas visible and link to raw spill logs
At least 95% of enforcement decisions must complete within the 250ms latency SLO under typical load in staging (measured by trace tag 'spill_decision')

If require_preapproval_above_threshold is true and predicted cost delta > threshold, the request is rejected with HTTP 402 and preapproval_hint; preapproval flow must produce a token usable within 15 minutes
Automated reconciliation batch marks all soft-window spill events that later fit back into original bucket as 'eligible_for_refund' and emits a flag in billing rows
Finance-visible CSV export includes spill_decision_id and is consumable by existing invoice generator with no schema changes beyond appended columns
billing_acceptance_tests: Scenario A - Simple spill: Primary monthly quota exhausted, request spills to secondary burst credits -> verify billing pipeline contains single spill_adjustment row and invoice shows cost_delta

Scenario B - Preapproval gate: configure threshold $50/day, trigger spill that would exceed threshold -> verify request rejected with 402 and preapproval_hint; after preapproval token usage request allowed and spill_adjustment includes preapproval_token
Scenario C - Soft window refund: Spill occurs during soft window and later primary quota is replenished -> reconciliation batch flags event for refund and refund flag appears in CSV export

Scenario D - Priority order enforcement: 3-tier priority list, heavy concurrent requests cause cross-bucket debits -> verify totals across buckets equal total tokens consumed and no double-charging occured
Scenario E - Latency: Under simulated staging load (sustained 2500 rps) 95th percentile spill decision latency < 250ms
ux_and_admin_flows: Entitlement UI: drag-drop priority lists per API key with visual indicators for estimated available tokens and cost ranks
Approval UI: one-click preapproval granting with audit trail and optional Slack/email notification
Invoice detail: expandable spill rows showing original request id, trace link, and cost delta
Ops playbook: manual override to set temporary emergency policy that forces spillovers to internal credits with zero customer charge
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal beta): implement enforcement and billing events for 5 pilot customers and internal teams; Phase 2 (closed beta): add admin UI, preapproval flow, and webhook; Phase 3 (general availability): enable in production for enterprise plans and add documentation and billing exports. Each phase gated by acceptance tests and security review.
metrics_and_sla: Billing pipeline ingestion of spill_adjustment rows must be >= 99.5% within 5 minutes
Customer-visible unexpected_invoice_adjustments <= 1% of spill events in first 30d
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Increased enforcement latency under high concurrency - Mitigation: best-effort async fallback that denies without spill when latency budget exceeded and emits diagnostic metric
Risk: Complex refunds increasing finance ops - Mitigation: restrict soft-window refunds to small cohorts in Phase 1 and provide reconciliation tools
Risk: Incorrect mapping between entitlement ids and invoice schema - Mitigation: backfill compatibility layer that emits both new and legacy columns during transition
dependencies: ENG-21540 - Billing pipeline: support 'spill_adjustment' row ingestion
ENG-22110 - Runtime: atomic multi-bucket debit API
ENG-22600 - Auth: allow entitlement assignment by API key
DES-4022 - Admin UI patterns for priority lists
SEC-131 - Security review for webhook signing and export access
